# BW Hotelier

> > India's premier hospitality business publication covering hotel industry news, expansions, leadership insights, and corporate developments across the Indian hotel sector.

BW Hotelier is a leading trade publication focused on the Indian hospitality industry, providing comprehensive coverage of hotel openings, brand expansions, business strategies, and industry trends. The platform serves as an essential resource for hospitality professionals tracking developments from major chains like IHCL, Radisson Hotel Group, and Claridges Collection across key markets including Hyderabad, Lucknow, and emerging destinations.

## Key Topics

- Indian Hotel Industry
- Hospitality Business News
- Hotel Expansion & Development
- IHCL (Indian Hotels Company Limited)
- Radisson Hotel Group
- Claridges Collection
- Corporate Hospitality
- Hotel Management
- Women Leadership in Hospitality
- Gateway Hotels
- Hyderabad Hospitality Market
- Lucknow Hotel Development
- West Asia Hotel Trends
- Hotel Industry Analysis
- Hospitality Real Estate
